goal: 25 seconds that feel like using Motion Studio: type a sentence, watch it get made — the loop itself as the teaser.
audience: a person who has never directed anything but has a phone full of clips and ideas
assumptions: 9:16 vertical (the request says vertical; a teaser lives in a feed)
the captures are the GUI's REAL pixels (studio capture against the running GUI) — never redrawn from imagination
the teaser is itself made in the studio (the proof is the process)

decision.why: A teaser is brand motion over captured truth: the capture service takes the GUI's real screenshots and the motion technique animates them in 9:16 with the studio's springs and a synthesized bed. The piece is the product's own loop, which only a designed timeline can compress into 25 seconds.

alternatives.rejected_because: there is no footage of the GUI being used — and a screen recording of a real production would take an hour to show what motion can compress into 25 seconds

alternatives.id: simplest: the captures as a slideshow with a title
alternatives.rejected_because: the simplest thing that could work — but 'what it feels like' is MOTION: the typed sentence landing, the film appearing; a slideshow tells instead of showing

segments.brief: Type a sentence (the request, animated as typing) -> the studio thinks (the plan/segments appearing) -> the film appears (the live seek view scrubbing) -> the gates go green -> 'made by one sentence'. All from the GUI's real captures, cut on beats.
acceptance: the captures are REAL (assets/ holds them; the palette sampled from site.json)
the hook lands in the first 2 seconds
the beats land on the grid

risks: the GUI captures need the GUI running
the teaser must not become a feature tour
